180	class OpenAIAdapter:
181	    def __init__(self, *, api_key: str, model_id: str, rates: ModelRates,
182	                 context_window_tokens: int, max_output_tokens: int,
183	                 timeout_sec: float = 60, reasoning_effort: str | None = None,
184	                 parallel_tool_calls: bool = True, strict_tools: bool = False,
185	                 long_context_rates: ModelRates | None = None,
186	                 max_retries: int = 2, sleep: Callable[[float], Awaitable[None]] = asyncio.sleep) -> None:
187	        if not api_key or not model_id or context_window_tokens <= max_output_tokens or max_output_tokens < 1:
188	            raise ModelConfigurationError("explicit model, API key and valid token limits are required")
189	        if not 0 <= max_retries <= 8:
190	            raise ModelConfigurationError("model retries must be between 0 and 8")
191	        self.model_id = model_id
192	        self.rates = rates
193	        self.long_context_rates = long_context_rates
194	        self.context_window_tokens = context_window_tokens
195	        self.max_output_tokens = max_output_tokens
196	        self.reasoning_effort = self._checked_effort(model_id, reasoning_effort)
197	        self.timeout_sec = timeout_sec
198	        self.parallel_tool_calls = parallel_tool_calls
199	        self.strict_tools = strict_tools
200	        self.max_retries = max_retries
201	        self._sleep = sleep
202	        if is_luna(model_id):
203	            if context_window_tokens > LUNA_WINDOW:
204	                raise ModelConfigurationError("gpt-6-luna window exceeds its verified provider limit")
205	            if self.max_input_tokens > LUNA_LONG_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD and long_context_rates is None:
206	                raise ModelConfigurationError("gpt-6-luna long context requires explicit long-context input and output rates")
207	            if long_context_rates is not None and (
208	                long_context_rates.input_per_million < rates.input_per_million or
209	                long_context_rates.output_per_million < rates.output_per_million
210	            ):
211	                raise ModelConfigurationError("long-context rates cannot be lower than standard rates")
212	        # Pin the official origin; user/model data and ambient OPENAI_BASE_URL
213	        # cannot redirect credentials. No hidden SDK retry may bypass the ledger.
214	        # `timeout_sec` bounds each wait for data (a reasoning model can think a while before its first token); connecting
215	        # gets a short limit of its own so an unreachable provider fails fast and is retried.
216	        self._client = AsyncOpenAI(api_key=api_key, base_url="https://api.openai.com/v1",
217	                                   timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout_sec, connect=min(CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SEC, timeout_sec)), max_retries=0)
218	
219	    @staticmethod
220	    def _checked_effort(model_id: str, effort: str | None) -> str | None:
221	        if effort is None:
222	            return None
223	        if effort not in EFFORTS or (support_for(model_id) and effort not in efforts_for(model_id)):
224	            raise ModelConfigurationError(f"{model_id} does not take reasoning effort {effort!r}")
225	        return effort
226	
227	    def with_reasoning_effort(self, effort: str | None) -> "OpenAIAdapter":
228	        """This adapter thinking at `effort` (None: the provider's own default); `self` is not modified.
229	
230	        It shares the client, so the ledger, the pinned origin and the no-hidden-retries rule are unchanged.
231	        """
232	        chosen = self._checked_effort(self.model_id, effort)
233	        if chosen == self.reasoning_effort:
234	            return self
235	        changed = copy.copy(self)
236	        changed.reasoning_effort = chosen
237	        return changed
238	
239	    @property
240	    def max_input_tokens(self) -> int:
241	        """The most input a request may carry once room for the reply is set aside."""
242	        return input_limit(self.model_id, self.context_window_tokens, self.max_output_tokens) or 0
243	
244	    @property
245	    def context_budget_tokens(self) -> int:
246	        """Estimated conversation size above which the runtime compacts old tool results: half of the
247	        usable window, which leaves room for what the next turn adds."""
248	        return self.max_input_tokens // 2
249	
250	    def with_output_limit(self, max_output_tokens: int) -> "OpenAIAdapter":
251	        """This adapter with replies capped at `max_output_tokens` (never above its own cap).
252	
253	        For small side requests, such as naming a conversation, whose worst-case cost should reflect the few
254	        tokens they can produce rather than a full answer. It shares the client, so the ledger, the pinned
255	        origin and the no-hidden-retries rule are unchanged; `self` is not modified.
256	        """
257	        if max_output_tokens < 1:
258	            raise ModelConfigurationError("an output limit must be positive")
259	        limited = copy.copy(self)
260	        limited.max_output_tokens = min(max_output_tokens, self.max_output_tokens)
261	        # A few tokens of output cannot hold any thinking, and a title or a summary gains nothing from it.
262	        if support_for(self.model_id) is not None:
263	            limited.reasoning_effort = "none"
264	        return limited
265	
266	    def maximum_request_cost(self, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], tools: list[dict[str, Any]]):
267	        count = conservative_input_tokens(messages, tools)
268	        if count > self.max_input_tokens:
269	            raise ModelContextLimit("bounded model context is exhausted")
270	        # Character estimates are useful for fitting, but cannot cap the cost of arbitrary text.
271	        # A byte-level upper bound also covers dense code and multilingual inputs. Successful
272	        # requests cannot exceed the provider input limit; rejected requests generate no output.
273	        byte_bound = len(json.dumps({"messages": messages, "tools": tools}, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))
274	        upper = min(self.max_input_tokens, byte_bound + PROTOCOL_OVERHEAD_TOKENS + PER_MESSAGE_OVERHEAD_TOKENS * len(messages))
275	        return self._rates_for(upper).cost(upper, self.max_output_tokens)
276	
277	    def _rates_for(self, input_tokens: int) -> ModelRates:
278	        if is_luna(self.model_id) and input_tokens > LUNA_LONG_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD and self.long_context_rates:
279	            return self.long_context_rates
280	        return self.rates
281	
282	    # --- request assembly -------------------------------------------------------------------
283	    def _request(self, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
284	                 tool_choice: dict[str, Any] | str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
285	        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
286	            "model": self.model_id, "messages": cast(list[ChatCompletionMessageParam], messages),
287	            "max_completion_tokens": self.max_output_tokens, "store": False, "service_tier": "default"}
288	        # gpt-6-luna reasons by default, and its Chat Completions endpoint takes function calls only without reasoning:
289	        # whatever effort is asked for, a request that reaches this endpoint says none (asked-for efforts use `_responses`).
290	        effort = "none" if is_luna(self.model_id) else self.reasoning_effort
291	        if effort is not None:
292	            kwargs["reasoning_effort"] = effort
293	        if tools:
294	            kwargs.update(tools=cast(list[ChatCompletionToolParam], tools),
295	                          tool_choice=tool_choice or "auto", parallel_tool_calls=self.parallel_tool_calls)
296	        return kwargs
297	
298	    # --- failure handling -------------------------------------------------------------------
299	    @staticmethod
300	    def _classify(exc: BaseException) -> ModelProviderError | ModelContextLimit:
301	        """Map an SDK failure to an error that carries the provider's own message (see `provider_detail`), so the
302	        person reads what the provider actually said. The request itself is never included."""
303	        if isinstance(exc, (ModelProviderError, ModelContextLimit)):
304	            return exc
305	        detail = provider_detail(exc)
306	        if isinstance(exc, openai.RateLimitError):
307	            if getattr(exc, "code", None) == "insufficient_quota":
308	                return ModelProviderError("model quota exhausted", code="MODEL_QUOTA_EXCEEDED", detail=detail)
309	            return ModelProviderError("model rate limited", code="RATE_LIMIT", retriable=True, detail=detail)
310	        if isinstance(exc, openai.BadRequestError) and getattr(exc, "code", None) == "context_length_exceeded":
311	            return ModelContextLimit(detail or "provider context window exceeded")
312	        if isinstance(exc, (openai.AuthenticationError, openai.PermissionDeniedError)):
313	            return ModelProviderError("model credentials were rejected", code="AUTH_ERROR", detail=detail)
314	        if isinstance(exc, openai.InternalServerError) or (
315	                isinstance(exc, openai.APIStatusError) and exc.status_code in (408, 409, 425, 502, 503, 504, 529)):
316	            return ModelProviderError("model provider unavailable", retriable=True, detail=detail)
317	        if isinstance(exc, openai.APITimeoutError):
318	            return ModelProviderError("model request timed out", retriable=True, detail=detail)
319	        if isinstance(exc, openai.APIConnectionError) or isinstance(exc, (httpx.TransportError, ConnectionError)):
320	            return ModelProviderError("model provider unreachable", retriable=True, detail=detail)
321	        if isinstance(exc, openai.APIError) and not isinstance(exc, (openai.APIStatusError, openai.APIResponseValidationError)):
322	            # An error frame inside a stream that had already answered 200 (`openai._streaming` raises it as a bare
323	            # APIError whose code and type come from the frame's `error` object): no status, so judge it by its kind.
324	            kinds = {getattr(exc, "code", None), getattr(exc, "type", None)} - {None}
325	            if "insufficient_quota" in kinds:
326	                return ModelProviderError("model quota exhausted", code="MODEL_QUOTA_EXCEEDED", detail=detail)
327	            if kinds & RATE_LIMIT_KINDS:
328	                return ModelProviderError("model rate limited", code="RATE_LIMIT", retriable=True, detail=detail)
329	            if not kinds or kinds & TRANSIENT_KINDS:
330	                return ModelProviderError("model provider unavailable", retriable=True, detail=detail)
331	        return ModelProviderError("model provider request failed", detail=detail)
332	
333	    @staticmethod
334	    def _retry_after(exc: BaseException) -> float | None:
335	        cause = exc.__cause__ if isinstance(exc, _StreamBroke) else exc
336	        try:
337	            headers = cause.response.headers  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
338	            if headers.get("retry-after-ms") is not None:
339	                return float(headers["retry-after-ms"]) / 1000
340	            value = headers.get("retry-after")
341	            return float(value) if value is not None else None
342	        except Exception:
343	            return None
344	
345	    async def _with_retries(self, call: Callable[[], Awaitable[ModelResponse]],
346	                            on_retry: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
347	                            on_attempt_failed: Callable[[str], None] | None = None) -> ModelResponse:
348	        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
349	            try:
350	                return await call()
351	            except ModelContextLimit:
352	                raise
353	            except Exception as exc:
354	                error = self._classify(exc.__cause__ if isinstance(exc, _StreamBroke) else exc)
355	                if not isinstance(error, ModelProviderError) or not error.retriable or attempt >= self.max_retries:
356	                    raise error from None
357	                if isinstance(exc, _StreamBroke) and on_retry is not None:
358	                    try:
359	                        on_retry()  # what the broken attempt showed is void
360	                    except Exception:
361	                        pass
362	                if on_attempt_failed is not None:
363	                    try:
364	                        on_attempt_failed(error.code)  # a request failed and is about to be sent again (tracing counts these)
365	                    except Exception:
366	                        pass
367	                wait = self._retry_after(exc)
368	                if wait is None:
369	                    # Equal jitter: at least half the exponential step, so retries back off, and a random rest, so
370	                    # requests that failed together do not all come back together.
371	                    base = BASE_RETRY_WAIT_SEC * (2 ** attempt)
372	                    wait = base / 2 + random.uniform(0, base / 2)
373	                await self._sleep(min(max(wait, 0.0), MAX_RETRY_WAIT_SEC))
374	        raise ModelProviderError("model provider request failed")  # unreachable; keeps the type checker honest
375	
376	    # --- completion -------------------------------------------------------------------------
377	    async def complete(self, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
378	                       on_text: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
379	                       tool_choice: dict[str, Any] | str | None = None,
380	                       on_narration: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
381	                       on_retry: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
382	                       on_tool: Callable[[int, str, str, str], None] | None = None,
383	                       on_attempt_failed: Callable[[str], None] | None = None) -> ModelResponse:
384	        """One completion. With on_text, the person-facing reply is delivered as it arrives; with on_narration,
385	        so is the plain text the model writes next to its tool calls; with on_tool, so is each tool call as the model
386	        writes it: `(index, call id, tool name, next piece of its JSON arguments)`, in the order the provider sends them.
387	        The returned response (message, usage, finish reason) is identical to the non-streaming path. `on_retry` runs
388	        before a broken stream is requested again, so the caller can clear what that attempt showed. `on_attempt_failed` is told
389	        the error code of every failed request that is about to be retried (rate limit, 5xx, timeout, broken stream)."""
390	        self.maximum_request_cost(messages, tools)
391	        if uses_responses(self.model_id, self.reasoning_effort):
392	            request = self._responses_request(messages, tools, tool_choice)
393	            if on_text is not None or on_narration is not None or on_tool is not None:
394	                return await self._with_retries(lambda: self._responses_streaming(request, bool(tools), on_text, on_narration, on_tool), on_retry, on_attempt_failed)
395	            return await self._with_retries(lambda: self._responses_once(request), None, on_attempt_failed)
396	        request = self._request(messages, tools, tool_choice)
397	        if on_text is not None or on_narration is not None or on_tool is not None:
398	            return await self._with_retries(lambda: self._complete_streaming(request, bool(tools), on_text, on_narration, on_tool), on_retry, on_attempt_failed)
399	        return await self._with_retries(lambda: self._complete_once(request), None, on_attempt_failed)
400	
401	    async def _complete_once(self, request: dict[str, Any]) -> ModelResponse:
402	        response = await self._client.chat.completions.create(**request)
403	        if not response.choices:
404	            raise ModelProviderError("model provider returned no completion")
405	        choice = response.choices[0]
406	        message = choice.message.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
407	        # Only documented replay fields are sent back. Never include parsed,
408	        # refusal metadata, audio, annotations or provider-specific extras.
409	        message = {key: message[key] for key in ("role", "content", "tool_calls") if key in message}
410	        usage = response.usage
411	        if usage is None:
412	            measured = ModelUsage(0, 0, None)
413	        else:
414	            measured = ModelUsage(usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens,
415	                                  self._rates_for(usage.prompt_tokens).cost(usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens))
416	        return ModelResponse(message, measured, response.model, choice.finish_reason)
417	
418	    async def _complete_streaming(self, request: dict[str, Any], has_tools: bool,
419	                                  on_text: Callable[[str], None] | None,
420	                                  on_narration: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
421	                                  on_tool: Callable[[int, str, str, str], None] | None = None) -> ModelResponse:
422	        parts: list[str] = []
423	        calls: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
424	        finish_reason: str | None = None
425	        usage = None
426	        reported_model = self.model_id
427	        stream = None
428	        received = False
429	
430	        def show(*piece, sink: Callable[..., None] | None = on_text) -> None:
431	            if sink is None:
432	                return
433	            try:
434	                sink(*piece)
435	            except Exception:
436	                pass  # Showing progress must never fail the model call.
437	
438	        try:
439	            stream = await self._client.chat.completions.create(
440	                **request, stream=True, stream_options={"include_usage": True})
441	            async for chunk in stream:
442	                if getattr(chunk, "usage", None) is not None:
443	                    usage = chunk.usage
444	                if getattr(chunk, "model", None):
445	                    reported_model = chunk.model
446	                if not chunk.choices:
447	                    continue
448	                received = True
449	                choice = chunk.choices[0]
450	                delta = choice.delta
451	                if delta is not None and delta.content:
452	                    parts.append(delta.content)
453	                    # With tools offered, content is narration written next to the calls, not the reply.
454	                    show(delta.content, sink=on_narration if has_tools else on_text)
455	                for call in (delta.tool_calls or []) if delta is not None else []:
456	                    slot = calls.setdefault(call.index, {"id": "", "type": "function", "function": {"name": "", "arguments": ""}})
457	                    if call.id:
458	                        slot["id"] = call.id
459	                    piece = ""
460	                    if call.function is not None:
461	                        slot["function"]["name"] += call.function.name or ""
462	                        piece = call.function.arguments or ""
463	                        slot["function"]["arguments"] += piece
464	                    show(call.index, slot["id"], slot["function"]["name"], piece, sink=on_tool)
465	                if choice.finish_reason:
466	                    finish_reason = choice.finish_reason
467	        except Exception as exc:
468	            if received and not isinstance(exc, (ModelProviderError, ModelContextLimit)):
469	                raise _StreamBroke() from exc
470	            raise self._classify(exc) from None
471	        finally:
472	            if stream is not None:
473	                try:
474	                    await stream.close()
475	                except Exception:
476	                    pass
477	        if finish_reason is None:
478	            if received:
479	                # The stream closed cleanly but cut short: what it showed is void, so it is retried like one that broke.
480	                raise _StreamBroke() from ModelProviderError(
481	                    "model provider stream ended before the reply finished", retriable=True, detail="no finish_reason")
482	            raise ModelProviderError("model provider returned no completion")
483	        content = "".join(parts)
484	        message: dict[str, Any] = {"role": "assistant"}
485	        if content or not calls:
486	            message["content"] = content
487	        if calls:
488	            message["tool_calls"] = [calls[index] for index in sorted(calls)]
489	        if usage is None:
490	            measured = ModelUsage(0, 0, None)
491	        else:
492	            measured = ModelUsage(usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens,
493	                                  self._rates_for(usage.prompt_tokens).cost(usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens))
494	        return ModelResponse(message, measured, reported_model, finish_reason)
495	
496	    # --- the Responses endpoint -------------------------------------------------------------
497	    def _responses_request(self, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
498	                           tool_choice: dict[str, Any] | str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
499	        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
500	            "model": self.model_id, "input": to_responses_input(messages), "max_output_tokens": self.max_output_tokens,
501	            "reasoning": {"effort": self.reasoning_effort}, "store": False, "service_tier": "default",
502	            # A model that thinks longer says nothing for longer before its first token.
503	            "timeout": httpx.Timeout(read_timeout(self.timeout_sec, self.reasoning_effort), connect=min(CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SEC, self.timeout_sec))}
504	        if tools:
505	            kwargs.update(tools=to_responses_tools(tools), tool_choice=to_responses_tool_choice(tool_choice),
506	                          parallel_tool_calls=self.parallel_tool_calls)
507	        return kwargs
508	
509	    def _responses_result(self, response: Any, reported_model: str | None = None) -> ModelResponse:
510	        message, finish = message_from_response(response)
511	        usage = response.usage
512	        if usage is None:
513	            measured = ModelUsage(0, 0, None)
514	        else:
515	            measured = ModelUsage(usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens,
516	                                  self._rates_for(usage.input_tokens).cost(usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens))
517	        return ModelResponse(message, measured, getattr(response, "model", None) or reported_model or self.model_id, finish)
518	
519	    async def _responses_once(self, request: dict[str, Any]) -> ModelResponse:
520	        try:
521	            response = await self._client.responses.create(**request)
522	        except Exception as exc:
523	            raise self._classify(exc) from None
524	        return self._responses_result(response)
525	
526	    async def _responses_streaming(self, request: dict[str, Any], has_tools: bool,
527	                                   on_text: Callable[[str], None] | None,
528	                                   on_narration: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
529	                                   on_tool: Callable[[int, str, str, str], None] | None = None) -> ModelResponse:
530	        final = None
531	        received = False
532	        stream = None
533	        slots: dict[int, tuple[int, str, str]] = {}  # output index -> (tool index, call id, name)
534	
535	        def show(*piece, sink: Callable[..., None] | None = on_text) -> None:
536	            if sink is None:
537	                return
538	            try:
539	                sink(*piece)
540	            except Exception:
541	                pass  # Showing progress must never fail the model call.
542	
543	        try:
544	            stream = await self._client.responses.create(**request, stream=True)
545	            async for event in stream:
546	                kind = event.type
547	                if kind in ("response.output_text.delta", "response.refusal.delta"):
548	                    received = True
549	                    # With tools offered, text is narration written next to the calls, not the reply.
550	                    show(event.delta, sink=on_narration if has_tools else on_text)
551	                elif kind == "response.output_item.added" and event.item.type == "function_call":
552	                    received = True
553	                    slots[event.output_index] = (len(slots), event.item.call_id, event.item.name)
554	                    show(*slots[event.output_index], "", sink=on_tool)
555	                elif kind == "response.function_call_arguments.delta" and event.output_index in slots:
556	                    index, call_id, name = slots[event.output_index]
557	                    show(index, call_id, name, event.delta, sink=on_tool)
558	                elif kind in ("response.completed", "response.incomplete"):
559	                    final = event.response
560	                elif kind == "response.failed":
561	                    raise _response_error(getattr(event.response, "error", None))
562	                elif kind == "error":
563	                    raise _response_error(event)
564	        except Exception as exc:
565	            if received and not isinstance(exc, (ModelProviderError, ModelContextLimit)):
566	                raise _StreamBroke() from exc
567	            raise self._classify(exc) from None
568	        finally:
569	            if stream is not None:
570	                try:
571	                    await stream.close()
572	                except Exception:
573	                    pass
574	        if final is None:
575	            if received:
576	                # The stream closed cleanly but cut short: what it showed is void, so it is retried like one that broke.
577	                raise _StreamBroke() from ModelProviderError(
578	                    "model provider stream ended before the reply finished", retriable=True, detail="no completed event")
579	            raise ModelProviderError("model provider returned no completion")
580	        return self._responses_result(final)
581	
582	    async def aclose(self) -> None:
583	        await self._client.close()

BUILTIN_CACHE_SEC = 60

def canonical_snapshot(definition: AgentDefinition) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    validated = AgentDefinition.model_validate_json(definition.model_dump_json())
    snapshot = validated.model_dump(mode="json")
    encoded = json.dumps(snapshot, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
    return snapshot, hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()


def load_builtin(name: str, version: int) -> AgentDefinition:
    if name not in BUILTIN_KEYS or type(version) is not int or version < 1:
        raise ScopeDenied("unknown built-in definition version")
    resource = files("agentforge.subagents.definitions").joinpath(f"{name}.v{version}.json")
    if not resource.is_file():
        raise ScopeDenied("unknown built-in definition version")
    definition = AgentDefinition.model_validate_json(resource.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if definition.name != name or definition.version != version or not definition.enabled:
        raise ScopeDenied("built-in resource identity is invalid")
    return definition


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResolvedDefinition:
    definition_id: UUID
    version_id: UUID
    key: str
    definition: AgentDefinition
    sha256: str


class AgentRegistry:

                return cached[1]
            resolved = self._resolve_builtin(key, parts[1], version)

                    raise ScopeDenied("invalid project namespace") from exc

                definition = AgentDefinition.model_validate_json(json.dumps(row.definition_json, allow_nan=False))

        budget_ceiling: Budget,
    ) -> ResolvedDefinition:
        """Internal owner-only management service; no HTTP endpoint in Phase 2.

        Project ownership supplies agent:manage in the single-owner MVP. The
        caller must obtain ceilings from server policy, never model input.
        """
        await self.authorizer.check_context(ctx)
        snapshot, digest = canonical_snapshot(definition)
        definition = AgentDefinition.model_validate_json(json.dumps(snapshot))
        if definition.name in BUILTIN_KEYS:
            raise ScopeDenied("built-in names are reserved")
        ceilings = [Permissions.model_validate_json(value.model_dump_json()) for value in (
            grant_ceiling, ctx.platform_permissions, ctx.user_permissions,
            ctx.task_permissions, ctx.parent_permissions,
        )]
        budgets = [Budget.model_validate_json(value.model_dump_json()) for value in (
            budget_ceiling, ctx.platform_budget, ctx.tier_budget, ctx.task_budget, ctx.parent_budget,
        )]
        for field in Permissions.model_fields:
            requested = getattr(definition.permissions, field)
            for ceiling in ceilings:

            project = session.scalar(select(Project).where(Project.id == ctx.project_id, Project.owner_id == ctx.user_id).with_for_update())

                raise ScopeDenied("project management is not authorized")

                project_id=ctx.project_id, agent_key=definition.name,

                version=definition.version,
            )
            return ResolvedDefinition(row.definition_id, row.id, f"project/{ctx.project_id}/{definition.name}", definition, digest)

    async def disable_project_definition(self, key: str, ctx: TaskContext) -> None:
        """Soft-disable a private agent while retaining all version history."""
        await self.authorizer.check_context(ctx)
        parts = key.split("/")
        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[:2] != ["project", str(ctx.project_id)] or parts[2] in BUILTIN_KEYS:
            raise ScopeDenied("project definition management requires its exact namespace")
        with self.session_factory() as session, session.begin():
            row = session.scalar(select(DefinitionRow).where(
                DefinitionRow.namespace == "project", DefinitionRow.project_id == ctx.project_id,
                DefinitionRow.agent_key == parts[2],
            ))
            if row is None:
                raise ScopeDenied("project definition is not available")
            DefinitionRepository(session).disable_project(
                project_id=ctx.project_id, definition_id=row.id, owner_id=ctx.user_id,
            )

            project = session.scalar(select(Project).where(Project.id == ctx.project_id, Project.owner_id == ctx.user_id).with_for_update())
            if project is None:
                raise ScopeDenied("project management is not authorized")
            row = DefinitionRepository(session).save_project(
                project_id=ctx.project_id, agent_key=definition.name,
                definition_json=snapshot, sha256=digest, created_by=ctx.user_id,
                version=definition.version,
            )
            return ResolvedDefinition(row.definition_id, row.id, f"project/{ctx.project_id}/{definition.name}", definition, digest)

    async def disable_project_definition(self, key: str, ctx: TaskContext) -> None:
        """Soft-disable a private agent while retaining all version history."""
        await self.authorizer.check_context(ctx)
        parts = key.split("/")
        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[:2] != ["project", str(ctx.project_id)] or parts[2] in BUILTIN_KEYS:
            raise ScopeDenied("project definition management requires its exact namespace")
        with self.session_factory() as session, session.begin():
            row = session.scalar(select(DefinitionRow).where(
                DefinitionRow.namespace == "project", DefinitionRow.project_id == ctx.project_id,
                DefinitionRow.agent_key == parts[2],
            ))
            if row is None:
                raise ScopeDenied("project definition is not available")
            DefinitionRepository(session).disable_project(
                project_id=ctx.project_id, definition_id=row.id, owner_id=ctx.user_id,
            )

313	    "line_start", "max_lines", "offset", "max_chars", "input_kind", "attachment_index", "issue_number", "pr_number",
314	    "command_id", "test_profile", "format", "max_results", "context_lines", "case_sensitive", "replace_all",
315	    "max_depth", "checks", "expected_sha256", "name"})
316	
317	
318	def safe_arguments(args) -> dict:
319	    """A bounded audit record of what a call asked for, without free text, queries or file content."""
320	    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
321	    record: dict = {}
322	    if isinstance(args, PluginArguments):
323	        # The names of the fields a plugin call carried, never what they held: its arguments are free text and file content.
324	        fields = args.model_dump(mode="json")
325	        return {"argument_count": len(fields), "fields": [str(key)[:40] for key in list(fields)[:20]]}
326	    for key, value in args.model_dump(mode="json").items():
327	        if value is None:
328	            continue
329	        if key in ("source_url", "url") and isinstance(value, str):
330	            record["host"] = (urlsplit(value).hostname or "")[:120]
331	        elif key in STRUCTURAL_FIELDS:
332	            record[key] = value[:200] if isinstance(value, str) else value
333	        elif isinstance(value, str):
334	            record[f"{key}_chars"] = len(value)
335	        elif isinstance(value, bool | int | float):
336	            record[key] = value
337	    return record
338	
339	
340	class ToolUnavailable(ValueError):
341	    """The platform has not installed this capability adapter."""
342	
343	
344	@dataclass(frozen=True)
345	class PluginTool:
346	    """A tool offered by a plugin's server: what the model is told, and what the server calls it."""
347	    plugin_id: str
348	    plugin_name: str
349	    remote_name: str
350	    title: str
351	    description: str
352	    input_schema: dict[str, Any]
353	    read_only: bool
354	
355	
356	@dataclass(frozen=True)
357	class RegisteredTool:
358	    name: str
359	    handler: ToolHandler
360	    max_cost_usd: Decimal
361	    timeout_sec: float
362	    preview: ToolPreview | None = None
363	    plugin: PluginTool | None = None
364	
365	    @property
366	    def input_model(self) -> type[BaseModel]:
367	        return PluginArguments if self.plugin is not None else ARGUMENT_MODELS[self.name]
368	
369	    @property
370	    def has_effects(self) -> bool:
371	        # A plugin tool that does not say it only reads is assumed to change something outside this app.
372	        return self.name in EFFECT_TOOLS or (self.plugin is not None and not self.plugin.read_only)
373	
374	    @property
375	    def asks_before(self) -> bool:
376	        return self.name in ASKS_BEFORE or (self.plugin is not None and not self.plugin.read_only)
377	
378	    def provider_schema(self, *, hide: frozenset[str] | set[str] = frozenset(), strict: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
379	        """The schema the model sees. `hide` removes fields the harness binds itself."""
380	        if self.plugin is not None:
381	            # The server's own schema, cleaned when it was saved. Not offered in strict form: it is not ours to rewrite.
382	            description = f"[{self.plugin.plugin_name}] {self.plugin.description or self.plugin.title or self.plugin.remote_name}"
383	            return {"type": "function", "function": {"name": self.name, "description": description[:1600], "parameters": self.plugin.input_schema}}
384	        parameters = drop_fields(clean_schema(self.input_model.model_json_schema()), hide)
385	        function: dict[str, Any] = {"name": self.name, "description": DESCRIPTIONS[self.name]}
386	        if strict:
387	            parameters = to_strict_schema(parameters)
388	            function["strict"] = True
389	        function["parameters"] = parameters
390	        return {"type": "function", "function": function}
391	
392	
393	class ToolCatalog:
394	    """Only trusted composition code registers adapters. A plugin's tools are registered the same way, per run, by
395	    `register_plugin`, from servers the person connected: they get no built-in tool's privileges.
396	
397	    Implementations must enforce DNS/redirect isolation for network tools and E2B
398	    isolation, command argument constraints and base hashes for sandbox tools.
399	    Before returning a large result, adapters must store the bounded full output
400	    under task-owned immutable evidence/artifact IDs. The child receives a
401	    preview; the audit digest alone is not a substitute for durable output.
402	    Registering a handler declares those guarantees; no default handler exists.
403	    """
404	
405	    def __init__(self) -> None:
406	        self._tools: dict[str, RegisteredTool] = {}
407	
408	    def register(self, name: str, handler: ToolHandler, *, max_cost_usd: Decimal, timeout_sec: float = 30,
409	                 preview: ToolPreview | None = None) -> None:
410	        if name not in ARGUMENT_MODELS:
411	            raise ToolUnavailable("tool is outside the platform allowlist")
412	        if name in self._tools:
413	            raise ValueError("tool adapter is already registered")
414	        if not isinstance(max_cost_usd, Decimal) or not max_cost_usd.is_finite() or max_cost_usd < 0:
415	            raise ValueError("adapter requires a nonnegative finite cost cap")
416	        if not 0 < timeout_sec:
417	            raise ValueError("adapter requires a positive timeout")
418	        self._tools[name] = RegisteredTool(name, handler, max_cost_usd, timeout_sec, preview)
419	
420	    def register_plugin(self, name: str, handler: ToolHandler, plugin: PluginTool, *, timeout_sec: float) -> None:
421	        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]*__[a-z0-9_-]+", name) or len(name) > 64 or name in ARGUMENT_MODELS:
422	            raise ToolUnavailable("plugin tool name is not allowed")
423	        if name in self._tools:
424	            raise ValueError("tool adapter is already registered")
425	        self._tools[name] = RegisteredTool(name, handler, Decimal(0), timeout_sec, None, plugin)
426	
427	    def plugin_tool_names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
428	        return tuple(name for name, tool in self._tools.items() if tool.plugin is not None)
429	
430	    def extra_tool_names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
431	        """Tools every run is offered whatever its definition lists: the ambient ones that are registered, then plugin tools."""
432	        return tuple(name for name in self._tools if name in AMBIENT_TOOLS) + self.plugin_tool_names()
433	
434	    def get(self, name: str) -> RegisteredTool:
435	        try:
436	            return self._tools[name]
437	        except KeyError:
438	            raise ToolUnavailable("tool adapter is unavailable") from None
439	
440	    def available(self, allowed_tools: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[RegisteredTool, ...]:
441	        return tuple(self._tools[name] for name in allowed_tools if name in self._tools)
442

"""A closed catalog whose capabilities exist only when an adapter is registered."""

    from .gateway import ToolExecutionContext

# Extra text for an approval card that only the adapter can produce (a pull request's changed files), read without effects.

# Static, safe guidance shown with a tool error so the model can correct itself. No provider text crosses this boundary.

GENERIC_ERROR_GUIDANCE = "The call did not succeed. Do not repeat it unchanged; adjust the arguments, try another approach, or record the gap."
# Many sites refuse automated readers outright (403, sign-in walls), and searching again rarely changes that. The search
# results already hold each page's text, so the model is pointed at what it has instead of at more searching.
FETCH_FAILURE_GUIDANCE = (
    "The page could not be fetched (blocked, missing, too large or not text); fetching it again will fail the same way. Do not "
    "search for the same page again. Use what you already have: the text of this task's web_search results (open one with "
    "read_research_source and its source_id) or another result from a different site. If that answers the request, answer now "
    "and say the page itself could not be opened.")


def error_guidance(code: str | None) -> str:
    if code in ERROR_GUIDANCE:
        return ERROR_GUIDANCE[code]
    if code and code.startswith("PLUGIN_"):
        return "The plugin could not do that. Read the detail; fix the call once if it was at fault, otherwise continue without the plugin and tell the person."
    if code and code.startswith("FETCH_"):
        return FETCH_FAILURE_GUIDANCE
    return GENERIC_ERROR_GUIDANCE


def clean_schema(node, *, names=False):
    """Drop pydantic's auto-generated titles; they add tokens without adding meaning."""
    if isinstance(node, list):
        return [clean_schema(item) for item in node]
    if not isinstance(node, dict):
        return node
    if names:  # a "properties" map: keys are field names and must be kept
        return {key: clean_schema(value) for key, value in node.items()}
    return {key: clean_schema(value, names=key == "properties") for key, value in node.items()
            if not (key == "title" and isinstance(value, str))}


def _page_label(url) -> str | None:
    """Host and path of a page, never its query string or fragment: enough to tell two pages of one site apart."""
    if not url.hostname:
        return None
    path = url.path.rstrip("/")
    return url.hostname + path if path else url.hostname


def activity_detail(name: str, args) -> str | None:
    """A short, safe label for what a tool call is about (query, site, path), shown to the task's owner as activity.

    It is derived only from already-validated arguments, never from tool output, and never includes file content.
    """
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    value = {
        "delegate_task": lambda: args.title,
        "web_search": lambda: args.query,
        "search_repo": lambda: args.query,
        "fetch_webpage": lambda: _page_label(urlsplit(args.source_url)),
        "browser_public_page": lambda: urlsplit(args.url).hostname,
        "read_repo_file": lambda: args.path,
        "read": lambda: args.path,
        "write": lambda: args.path,
        "edit": lambda: args.path,
        "ls": lambda: None if args.path == "." else args.path,
        "find": lambda: args.pattern,
        "grep": lambda: args.pattern,
        "bash": lambda: args.command,
        "create_pull_request": lambda: args.title,
        "list_repo_files": lambda: None if args.path == "." else args.path,
        "get_issue": lambda: f"#{args.issue_number}",
        "get_pr_status": lambda: f"#{args.pr_number}",
        "create_task_artifact": lambda: args.title,
        "use_skill": lambda: args.name,
        "read_task_input": lambda: args.input_kind,
    }.get(name)
    try:
        text = value() if value else None
    except AttributeError:
        return None
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return None
    text = "".join(char if char.isprintable() else " " for char in text)
    text = " ".join(text.split())[:120]
    return text or None


# Offered to every conversation run beside the tools its agent definition lists, when an adapter for them is registered.
AMBIENT_TOOLS = frozenset({"use_skill"})
EFFECT_TOOLS = frozenset({"delegate_task", "create_task_artifact", "bash", "write", "edit", "create_pull_request"})
# The calls that stop and ask the person first when they chose "Ask me" (see tools/approvals.py). Reads never ask.
ASKS_BEFORE = frozenset({"bash", "write", "edit", "create_pull_request"})


# What an approval card can show, measured as the escaped JSON that carries it (an event payload is capped at 16 KB).
APPROVAL_DETAIL_BYTES = 13000


def approval_summary(name: str, args, extra: str = "", plugin: "PluginTool | None" = None) -> tuple[str, bool]:
    """What the approval card shows, exactly as the call will use it: the whole command, the file and its whole new content,
    the text an edit replaces and its replacement, the pull request's title and description (and `extra`, the files it
    changes). Nothing is redacted, since a rewritten command is not the command that runs. The flag says the text had to be
    cut to fit the card."""
    if plugin is not None:
        arguments = json.dumps(args.model_dump(mode="json"), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        text = f"{plugin.plugin_name}: {plugin.title or plugin.remote_name}\n\n{arguments}"
    elif name == "bash":
        text = args.command
    elif name == "write":
        text = f"{args.path}\n\n{args.content}"
    elif name == "edit":
        text = (f"{args.path}\n\nReplace{' every occurrence of' if args.replace_all else ''}:\n{args.old_string}\n\n"
                f"With:\n{args.new_string}")
    elif name == "create_pull_request":
        text = f"{args.title}\n\n{args.body}".rstrip()
    else:
        text = ""
    if extra:
        text = f"{text}\n\n{extra}"
    shown = text
    while len(json.dumps(shown).encode()) > APPROVAL_DETAIL_BYTES:
        shown = shown[:int(len(shown) * 0.8)]
    return shown, shown != text

# Identifiers the model would otherwise copy from the brief on every call. When the harness can bind
# one to the task's single authorized value it hides the field from the schema and fills it in itself.
BINDABLE_FIELDS = frozenset({"repo_id", "ref", "base_ref", "sandbox_id", "task_id"})

# Free text and file content never enter the audit trail; only structural values and lengths do.
STRUCTURAL_FIELDS = frozenset({
    "path", "path_prefix", "repo_id", "ref", "base_ref", "sandbox_id", "task_id", "run_id", "source_id", "artifact_id",
    "line_start", "max_lines", "offset", "max_chars", "input_kind", "attachment_index", "issue_number", "pr_number",
    "command_id", "test_profile", "format", "max_results", "context_lines", "case_sensitive", "replace_all",
    "max_depth", "checks", "expected_sha256", "name"})


def safe_arguments(args) -> dict:
    """A bounded audit record of what a call asked for, without free text, queries or file content."""
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    record: dict = {}
    if isinstance(args, PluginArguments):
        # The names of the fields a plugin call carried, never what they held: its arguments are free text and file content.
        fields = args.model_dump(mode="json")
        return {"argument_count": len(fields), "fields": [str(key)[:40] for key in list(fields)[:20]]}
    for key, value in args.model_dump(mode="json").items():
        if value is None:
            continue
        if key in ("source_url", "url") and isinstance(value, str):
            record["host"] = (urlsplit(value).hostname or "")[:120]
        elif key in STRUCTURAL_FIELDS:
            record[key] = value[:200] if isinstance(value, str) else value
        elif isinstance(value, str):
            record[f"{key}_chars"] = len(value)
        elif isinstance(value, bool | int | float):
            record[key] = value
    return record


class ToolUnavailable(ValueError):
    """The platform has not installed this capability adapter."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PluginTool:
    """A tool offered by a plugin's server: what the model is told, and what the server calls it."""
    plugin_id: str
    plugin_name: str
    remote_name: str
    title: str
    description: str
    input_schema: dict[str, Any]
    read_only: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RegisteredTool:
    name: str
    handler: ToolHandler
    max_cost_usd: Decimal
    timeout_sec: float
    preview: ToolPreview | None = None
    plugin: PluginTool | None = None

    @property
    def input_model(self) -> type[BaseModel]:
        return PluginArguments if self.plugin is not None else ARGUMENT_MODELS[self.name]

    @property
    def has_effects(self) -> bool:
        # A plugin tool that does not say it only reads is assumed to change something outside this app.
        return self.name in EFFECT_TOOLS or (self.plugin is not None and not self.plugin.read_only)

    @property
    def asks_before(self) -> bool:
        return self.name in ASKS_BEFORE or (self.plugin is not None and not self.plugin.read_only)

    def provider_schema(self, *, hide: frozenset[str] | set[str] = frozenset(), strict: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """The schema the model sees. `hide` removes fields the harness binds itself."""
        if self.plugin is not None:
            # The server's own schema, cleaned when it was saved. Not offered in strict form: it is not ours to rewrite.
            description = f"[{self.plugin.plugin_name}] {self.plugin.description or self.plugin.title or self.plugin.remote_name}"
            return {"type": "function", "function": {"name": self.name, "description": description[:1600], "parameters": self.plugin.input_schema}}
        parameters = drop_fields(clean_schema(self.input_model.model_json_schema()), hide)
        function: dict[str, Any] = {"name": self.name, "description": DESCRIPTIONS[self.name]}
        if strict:
            parameters = to_strict_schema(parameters)
            function["strict"] = True
        function["parameters"] = parameters
        return {"type": "function", "function": function}


class ToolCatalog:
    """Only trusted composition code registers adapters. A plugin's tools are registered the same way, per run, by
    `register_plugin`, from servers the person connected: they get no built-in tool's privileges.

    Implementations must enforce DNS/redirect isolation for network tools and E2B
    isolation, command argument constraints and base hashes for sandbox tools.
    Before returning a large result, adapters must store the bounded full output
    under task-owned immutable evidence/artifact IDs. The child receives a
    preview; the audit digest alone is not a substitute for durable output.
    Registering a handler declares those guarantees; no default handler exists.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._tools: dict[str, RegisteredTool] = {}

    def register(self, name: str, handler: ToolHandler, *, max_cost_usd: Decimal, timeout_sec: float = 30,
                 preview: ToolPreview | None = None) -> None:
        if name not in ARGUMENT_MODELS:
            raise ToolUnavailable("tool is outside the platform allowlist")
        if name in self._tools:
            raise ValueError("tool adapter is already registered")
        if not isinstance(max_cost_usd, Decimal) or not max_cost_usd.is_finite() or max_cost_usd < 0:
            raise ValueError("adapter requires a nonnegative finite cost cap")
        if not 0 < timeout_sec:
            raise ValueError("adapter requires a positive timeout")
        self._tools[name] = RegisteredTool(name, handler, max_cost_usd, timeout_sec, preview)

    def register_plugin(self, name: str, handler: ToolHandler, plugin: PluginTool, *, timeout_sec: float) -> None:
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]*__[a-z0-9_-]+", name) or len(name) > 64 or name in ARGUMENT_MODELS:
            raise ToolUnavailable("plugin tool name is not allowed")
        if name in self._tools:
            raise ValueError("tool adapter is already registered")
        self._tools[name] = RegisteredTool(name, handler, Decimal(0), timeout_sec, None, plugin)

    def plugin_tool_names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return tuple(name for name, tool in self._tools.items() if tool.plugin is not None)

    def extra_tool_names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Tools every run is offered whatever its definition lists: the ambient ones that are registered, then plugin tools."""
        return tuple(name for name in self._tools if name in AMBIENT_TOOLS) + self.plugin_tool_names()

    def get(self, name: str) -> RegisteredTool:
        try:
            return self._tools[name]
        except KeyError:
            raise ToolUnavailable("tool adapter is unavailable") from None

    def available(self, allowed_tools: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[RegisteredTool, ...]:
        return tuple(self._tools[name] for name in allowed_tools if name in self._tools)

5	provider's strict structured-output dialect (every field required, optional ones nullable).

7	
8	from copy import deepcopy

11	# Keywords strict structured outputs may reject. Their meaning is folded into the field description,
12	# and the gateway still enforces every bound when the arguments arrive.
13	_STRIPPED = ("minLength", "maxLength", "minItems", "maxItems", "uniqueItems", "default", "title")

16	def drop_fields(schema: dict[str, Any], hidden: frozenset[str] | set[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
17	    """Remove top-level properties (and their required entries) the harness fills in itself."""
18	    if not hidden:
19	        return schema
20	    result = dict(schema)
21	    result["properties"] = {key: value for key, value in schema.get("properties", {}).items() if key not in hidden}
22	    required = [key for key in schema.get("required", []) if key not in hidden]
23	    if required:
24	        result["required"] = required
25	    else:
26	        result.pop("required", None)
27	    return result

30	def _fold_bounds(node: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
31	    notes = []
32	    if "minLength" in node:
33	        notes.append(f"at least {node['minLength']} characters")
34	    if "maxLength" in node:
35	        notes.append(f"at most {node['maxLength']} characters")
36	    if "minItems" in node:
37	        notes.append(f"at least {node['minItems']} items")
38	    if "maxItems" in node:
39	        notes.append(f"at most {node['maxItems']} items")
40	    if notes:
41	        description = node.get("description", "")
42	        node["description"] = (description + (" " if description else "") + "(" + ", ".join(notes) + ")").strip()
43	
44	
45	def _strict(node: Any) -> Any:
46	    if isinstance(node, list):
47	        return [_strict(item) for item in node]
48	    if not isinstance(node, dict):
49	        return node
50	    node = dict(node)
51	    _fold_bounds(node)
52	    for key in _STRIPPED:
53	        node.pop(key, None)
54	    for key in ("anyOf", "oneOf", "allOf"):
55	        if key in node:
56	            node[key] = [_strict(item) for item in node[key]]
57	    if isinstance(node.get("items"), dict):
58	        node["items"] = _strict(node["items"])
59	    if "$defs" in node:
60	        node["$defs"] = {name: _strict(value) for name, value in node["$defs"].items()}
61	    if node.get("type") == "object" or "properties" in node:
62	        required = set(node.get("required", []))
63	        properties: dict[str, Any] = {}
64	        for name, value in node.get("properties", {}).items():
65	            converted = _strict(value)
66	            nullable = any(isinstance(option, dict) and option.get("type") == "null" for option in converted.get("anyOf", []))
67	            if name not in required and not nullable:
68	                converted = {"anyOf": [converted, {"type": "null"}],
69	                             **({"description": converted["description"]} if "description" in converted else {})}
70	            properties[name] = converted
71	        node["properties"] = properties
72	        node["required"] = list(properties)
73	        node["additionalProperties"] = False
74	    return node

78	    """The same contract in strict structured-output form. Optional fields become required-but-nullable."""
79	    return _strict(deepcopy(schema))

216	    error_code: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=64, pattern=r"^[A-Z_]+$")
217	    # Safe, human-written explanation of an error, shown to the model next to the static guidance.
218	    error_detail: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=600)
219	
220	    @model_validator(mode="after")
221	    def bounded(self) -> Self:
222	        if self.cost_usd is not None and (not self.cost_usd.is_finite() or self.cost_usd < 0):
223	            raise ValueError("invalid tool cost")
224	        if self.status == "error" and self.error_code is None:
225	            raise ValueError("tool errors require a safe code")
226	        if len(self.evidence_ids) > 100 or len(self.artifact_ids) > 100:
227	            raise ValueError("too many result references")
228	        if len(json.dumps(self.model_dump(mode="json"), allow_nan=False).encode()) > 262144:
229	            raise ValueError("tool result exceeds bounded storage limit")
230	        return self

1	"""Validate and reauthorize every call, commit intent, then execute a bounded adapter.
2	
3	Beyond authorization the gateway is what makes calls precise: it binds identifiers the task already
4	fixes (repository, ref, sandbox), tells the model exactly which field of a call was wrong, and lets
5	independent read-only calls and delegations run side by side while other effectful ones stay strictly serial. It does not
6	count or cap calls: how many a run makes is the model's decision. The one thing it remembers is a call that failed in a
7	way that cannot change (a page that refused this server, or is not text): the identical call is answered from that
8	failure instead of being sent again (`REPEATED_FAILED_CALL`).
9	"""
10	
11	import asyncio
12	import hashlib
13	import json
14	import re
15	import time
16	from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
17	from contextlib import nullcontext
18	from dataclasses import dataclass
19	from decimal import Decimal
20	from uuid import UUID
21	
22	from pydantic import ValidationError

24	from agentforge.repositories.runs import ToolCallRepository
25	from agentforge.security.policies import PublicURL, authorize_tool

28	from agentforge.subagents.resources import ResourceResolver
29	from agentforge.subagents.scope import EffectiveScope, ScopeDenied, TaskContext

31	from .catalog import (
32	    BINDABLE_FIELDS, EFFECT_TOOLS, ToolCatalog, ToolUnavailable, activity_detail, approval_summary, safe_arguments,
33	)
34	from .contracts import ARGUMENT_MODELS, ToolOutcome
35	from .delegation import delegated_run_id
36	from .errors import ToolError, render_issues, validation_issues
37	from .lifecycle import CallLifecycle, LifecycleSink, execution_labels, outcome_from_row

39	READ_CONCURRENCY = 4
40	# Failures the same arguments will meet again within a run (the page answered, and the answer was no). Retrying one is
41	# a wasted round trip and a wasted model step, so the identical call is answered from the first failure. Network
42	# errors, timeouts and refusals of scope are not here: a later search can make a refused URL reachable.
43	DETERMINISTIC_FAILURES = frozenset({
44	    "FETCH_HTTP_ERROR", "FETCH_COMPRESSED_CONTENT_REJECTED", "FETCH_CONTENT_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED", "FETCH_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE",
45	    "FETCH_REDIRECT_OFF_HOST", "FETCH_REDIRECT_LIMIT", "FETCH_EMPTY_CONTENT",
46	})
47	# The most a call's JSON arguments may hold; larger calls are refused before they run (see `_run`).
48	MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES = 131072
49	# The tools whose output is shown while they run: a command can take minutes, the others finish at once.
50	STREAMED_OUTPUT = frozenset({"bash"})
51	# Effect tools that do not wait for the run's other effects. A delegation runs under its own gateway, ledger and approvals, so
52	# the assignments of one turn work side by side; `ChildRuntime` starts them together when a turn asks for several.
53	CONCURRENT_EFFECTS = frozenset({"delegate_task"})
54	
55	
56	class UnknownToolOutcome(RuntimeError):
57	    """An effect may have occurred; stop rather than automatically repeating it."""
58	
59	
60	@dataclass(frozen=True)
61	class ToolExecutionContext:
62	    task: TaskContext
63	    agent_run_id: UUID
64	    operation_key: str
65	    # The adapter can use this key for external idempotency/reconciliation.
66	    scope: EffectiveScope
67	    authorized_web_url: PublicURL | None = None
68	    authorized_web_hosts: tuple[str, ...] = ()
69	    authorize_current: Callable[[], Awaitable[None]] | None = None
70	    # Where a running tool may send its output as it arrives (a command's lines); None: nothing is shown before it ends.
71	    output: Callable[[str], None] | None = None

73	
74	class ToolGateway:
75	    def __init__(self, *, catalog: ToolCatalog, calls: ToolCallRepository,
76	                 budgets: BudgetService, resources: ResourceResolver,
77	                 reauthorize: Callable[[], Awaitable[None]], ctx: TaskContext,
78	                 scope: EffectiveScope, run_id: UUID, reservation_id: UUID,
79	                 strict_tools: bool = False, lifecycle: LifecycleSink | None = None, approvals=None, live=None,
80	                 trace=None) -> None:
81	        self.catalog, self.calls, self.budgets, self.resources = catalog, calls, budgets, resources
82	        # Opens a tracing span (`Telemetry.span`): approvals and refused calls show up in the trace as guardrail checks.
83	        # None: nothing is traced here.
84	        self.trace = trace
85	        # Asks the person before a tool that changes something runs (see tools/approvals.py); None: nothing asks.
86	        self.approvals = approvals
87	        # Receives tool.started / tool.finished (see tools/lifecycle.py); without one the gateway reports nothing.
88	        self.lifecycle = lifecycle
89	        # The live view of the run (`ReplyStream`): shows a call being written until its row starts, and a command's
90	        # output while it runs. None: only the saved events show anything.
91	        self.live = live
92	        self.reauthorize, self.ctx, self.scope = reauthorize, ctx, scope
93	        self.run_id, self.reservation_id = run_id, reservation_id
94	        self.strict_tools = strict_tools
95	        self._attempts = 0
96	        # (tool, canonical arguments) -> the code it failed with, for DETERMINISTIC_FAILURES only.
97	        self._failed: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
98	        # Effectful calls are serialized; independent reads may overlap up to READ_CONCURRENCY.
99	        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
100	        self._reads = asyncio.Semaphore(READ_CONCURRENCY)
101	
102	    # --- what the model sees --------------------------------------------------------------
103	    def bindings(self, name: str) -> dict[str, str]:
104	        """Identifiers the task fixes for this tool; the model neither supplies nor sees them."""
105	        model = ARGUMENT_MODELS.get(name)
106	        if model is None:
107	            return {}
108	        values: dict[str, str] = {}
109	        resolver = getattr(self.resources, "bindings", None)
110	        if resolver is not None:
111	            try:
112	                values.update(resolver(self.ctx, name))
113	            except ScopeDenied:
114	                values = {}
115	        if "task_id" in model.model_fields:
116	            values["task_id"] = str(self.ctx.task_id)
117	        return {key: value for key, value in values.items()
118	                if key in model.model_fields and key in BINDABLE_FIELDS and isinstance(value, str) and value}
119	
120	    def schemas(self) -> list[dict]:
121	        return [tool.provider_schema(hide=frozenset(self.bindings(tool.name)), strict=self.strict_tools)
122	                for tool in self.catalog.available(self.scope.allowed_tools)]
123	
124	    def _is_paid(self, name: str) -> bool:
125	        try:
126	            return self.catalog.get(name).max_cost_usd > 0
127	        except ToolUnavailable:
128	            return False
129	
130	    def _changes_things(self, name: str) -> bool:
131	        try:
132	            return self.catalog.get(name).has_effects
133	        except ToolUnavailable:
134	            return name in EFFECT_TOOLS
135	
136	    def is_parallel_safe(self, name: str) -> bool:
137	        """Read-only and free, so it may run alongside other reads. A delegation may too: it only ever touches its own run."""
138	        return name in self.scope.allowed_tools and (name in CONCURRENT_EFFECTS or (not self._changes_things(name) and not self._is_paid(name)))
139	
140	    # --- argument handling ------------------------------------------------------------------
141	    @staticmethod
142	    def _loads(raw_args: str):
143	        """The JSON object a model meant: empty arguments are `{}`, and a Markdown code fence around it is ignored.
144	        Anything else is not guessed at (two objects run together may be two calls); validation still applies."""
145	        text = raw_args.strip()
146	        if not text:
147	            return {}
148	        try:
149	            return json.loads(text)
150	        except ValueError:
151	            return json.loads(re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*|\s*```$", "", text))
152	
153	    def _parse(self, name: str, tool, raw_args: str):
154	        try:
155	            data = self._loads(raw_args)
156	        except ValueError as exc:
157	            # Where the parser gave up, never the text around it: the arguments may hold file content.
158	            where = f" ({exc.msg} at character {exc.pos})" if isinstance(exc, json.JSONDecodeError) else ""
159	            raise ToolError("SCHEMA_INVALID", f"The arguments are not valid JSON{where}. Send one JSON object.") from None
160	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
161	            raise ToolError("SCHEMA_INVALID", "The arguments must be one JSON object.")
162	        fields = tool.input_model.model_fields
163	        for key in [key for key, value in data.items() if value is None and key in fields and not fields[key].is_required()]:
164	            del data[key]  # a strict-schema model sends null for an omitted optional field
165	        for key, value in self.bindings(name).items():
166	            if key in data and data[key] != value:
167	                raise ToolError("SCOPE_DENIED", f"{key} is fixed for this task and not yours to choose; omit it.")
168	            data[key] = value
169	        try:
170	            return tool.input_model.model_validate_json(json.dumps(data))
171	        except ValidationError as exc:
172	            issues = validation_issues(exc)
173	            raise ToolError("SCHEMA_INVALID", render_issues(issues), issues=issues) from None
174	
175	    # --- tracing ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
176	    def _check(self, name: str):
177	        """A guardrail span, or a no-op without tracing."""
178	        return self.trace(name, kind="GUARDRAIL") if self.trace is not None else nullcontext(None)
179	
180	    def _record_refusal(self, tool: str, code: str) -> None:
181	        """A call that was refused before it ran, as a failed guardrail check in the trace. Never raises."""
182	        if self.trace is None or code == "DECLINED":   # a declined call already has its approval check
183	            return
184	        try:
185	            with self._check("tool_policy") as check:
186	                set_attributes(check, {"neatlogs.guardrail.name": "tool_policy", "neatlogs.guardrail.passed": False,
187	                    "neatlogs.guardrail.reason": code, "tool.name": tool, "agentforge.error.code": code,
188	                    "task_id": str(self.ctx.task_id), "spawn_id": str(self.run_id)})
189	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
190	            pass
191	
192	    # --- execution --------------------------------------------------------------------------
193	    async def execute(self, name: str, raw_args: str, provider_call_id: str) -> ToolOutcome:
194	        if name in CONCURRENT_EFFECTS:
195	            return await self._run(name, raw_args, provider_call_id)
196	        if self._changes_things(name) or self._is_paid(name):
197	            async with self._lock:
198	                return await self._run(name, raw_args, provider_call_id)
199	        async with self._reads:
200	            return await self._run(name, raw_args, provider_call_id)
201	
202	    async def _run(self, name: str, raw_args: str, provider_call_id: str) -> ToolOutcome:
203	        started = time.monotonic()
204	        self._attempts += 1
205	        if not provider_call_id or len(provider_call_id) > 100:
206	            raise ValueError("invalid_provider_call_id")
207	        attempt = self._attempts
208	        operation_key = f"{self.run_id}:tool:{provider_call_id}"
209	        # Private argument content is represented by an immutable digest;
210	        # no source code, .env data or prompt fragments enter audit metadata.
211	        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw_args.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
212	        # A name the run may not call is stored (and shown) as "unknown": the model's text never becomes a tool name.
213	        stored_name = name if name in self.scope.allowed_tools else "unknown"
214	        call_id = self.calls.record_intent(
215	            task_id=self.ctx.task_id, run_id=self.run_id, tool_name=stored_name,
216	            args_digest=digest, intent_json_sanitized={"arguments_sha256": digest},
217	            operation_key=operation_key,
218	        )
219	        events = CallLifecycle(self.lifecycle, tool=stored_name, tool_call_id=call_id,
220	                               agent_run_id=self.run_id, operation_key=operation_key)
221	        if name == "delegate_task":
222	            # Names the child so the chat can put its progress on this call's card (the child run id derives from the call).
223	            events.extra = {"child_run_id": str(delegated_run_id(operation_key))}
224	        authorized = False
225	        entered_adapter = False
226	        tool = None
227	        arguments: dict = {}
228	        live_call = events.ids["call_id"] if self.live is not None else None
229	        try:
230	            await self.reauthorize()
231	            self.budgets.check_active(self.reservation_id)
232	            tool = self.catalog.get(name)
233	            if name not in self.scope.allowed_tools:
234	                raise ScopeDenied("tool is not authorized for this run")
235	            if len(raw_args.encode("utf-8")) > MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES:
236	                # Refused like any other bad argument, before anything runs, so the model learns to send less at once.
237	                raise ToolError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", f"The arguments are larger than {MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES // 1024} KB, so the call was "
238	                                "not run. Split the work into parts: write the first part of a large file, then add the rest "
239	                                "with further edits, or use several smaller files.")
240	            args = self._parse(name, tool, raw_args)
241	            arguments = safe_arguments(args)
242	            # Parsed, so key order and spacing do not make the same call look new.
243	            repeat_key = (name, hashlib.sha256(args.model_dump_json().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest())
244	            if repeat_key in self._failed:
245	                raise ToolError("REPEATED_FAILED_CALL", f"This exact call already failed in this run with "
246	                                f"{self._failed[repeat_key]} and would fail the same way, so it was not sent again.")
247	            plugin = tool.plugin
248	            events.detail = activity_detail(name, args) if plugin is None else (plugin.title or plugin.remote_name)[:120]
249	            web_url, web_hosts = None, ()
250	            if name in ("fetch_webpage", "browser_public_page"):
251	                resolver = getattr(self.resources, "resolve_web_url", None)
252	                if resolver is None:
253	                    raise ScopeDenied("trusted network resource resolver is unavailable")
254	                async with asyncio.timeout(min(15, tool.timeout_sec)):
255	                    web_url, web_hosts = await resolver(self.ctx, name, args, self.scope)
256	            # A plugin's arguments are its server's business: the built-in tools' path, repository and URL rules do not
257	            # apply to them (a plugin tool may legitimately take a "path" or "url"), and it is reached only through the
258	            # allowlist above, never through the sandbox or the repository.
259	            if plugin is None:
260	                authorize_tool(name, args, self.ctx, self.scope, resolved_web_url=web_url)
261	            await self.resources.verify_tool_inputs(self.ctx, name, args)
262	            if self.approvals is not None and tool.asks_before:
263	                extra = ""
264	                asks = getattr(self.approvals, "asks", None)
265	                if tool.preview is not None and (asks is None or await asks(self.ctx)):
266	                    try:
267	                        async with asyncio.timeout(60):
268	                            extra = await tool.preview(args, ToolExecutionContext(
269	                                self.ctx, self.run_id, operation_key, self.scope, web_url, web_hosts, self.reauthorize))
270	                    except ToolError:
271	                        raise
272	                    except Exception:
273	                        extra = "(The list of changed files could not be read.)"
274	                summary, truncated = approval_summary(name, args, extra, plugin)
275	                # A subagent's card says whose it is: several can be waiting at once, with commands that look alike.
276	                whose = {"agent_run_id": str(self.run_id)} if getattr(self.ctx, "parent_run_id", None) is not None else {}
277	                with self._check("tool_approval") as check:
278	                    allowed = await self.approvals.allows(self.ctx, operation_key=operation_key, tool=name, summary=summary,
279	                        truncated=truncated, detail=arguments, check=self.reauthorize, **whose)
280	                    set_attributes(check, {"neatlogs.guardrail.name": "tool_approval", "neatlogs.guardrail.passed": bool(allowed),
281	                        "neatlogs.guardrail.reason": "APPROVED" if allowed else "DECLINED", "tool.name": name,
282	                        "task_id": str(self.ctx.task_id), "spawn_id": str(self.run_id)})
283	                if not allowed:
284	                    raise ToolError("DECLINED", "The person declined this action, so nothing was run. Do not do it another way "
285	                                    "without asking: say what you were about to do and ask how they want to continue.")
286	                # A call's duration is how long it ran, not how long it waited for the person.
287	                started = time.monotonic()
288	            # Announced just before the budget is claimed so a failed event write costs nothing; a refusal
289	            # from here on shows as a blocked step.
290	            events.start()
291	            self.budgets.authorize_operation(self.reservation_id, operation_key,
292	                                            tool.max_cost_usd, kind="tool")
293	            authorized = True
294	            entered_adapter = True
295	            output = None
296	            if live_call is not None:
297	                # The call's own row now stands in for it being written. A command's output follows live, under that row.
298	                if name in STREAMED_OUTPUT:
299	                    output = self.live.output(live_call, name)
300	                else:
301	                    self.live.settle(live_call)
302	            async with asyncio.timeout(tool.timeout_sec):
303	                raw_result = await tool.handler(args, ToolExecutionContext(
304	                    self.ctx, self.run_id, operation_key, self.scope, web_url, web_hosts, self.reauthorize, output))
305	            # Revalidate model_copy/model_construct output from trusted
306	            # adapter code before handing any data or IDs to the child.
307	            if not isinstance(raw_result, ToolOutcome):
308	                raise ValueError("invalid_adapter_result")
309	            result = ToolOutcome.model_validate_json(raw_result.model_dump_json())
310	            stored_result = False
311	            saver = getattr(self.calls, "store_result", None)
312	            if saver is not None and name != "read_context_resource":
313	                reference = saver(self.ctx.task_id, operation_key, result)
314	                stored_result = True
315	                result = result.model_copy(update={"data": {**result.data, "resource_id": reference}})
316	            self.budgets.record_usage(self.reservation_id, operation_key, result.cost_usd)
317	            authorized = False  # usage was durably recorded
318	            if result.cost_usd is not None and result.cost_usd > tool.max_cost_usd:
319	                raise UnknownToolOutcome("adapter_cost_bound_exceeded")
320	            await self.resources.verify_references(self.ctx, evidence_ids=result.evidence_ids,
321	                                                   artifact_ids=result.artifact_ids)
322	            if len(json.dumps(result.data, ensure_ascii=False).encode()) > 16000 and not (result.evidence_ids or result.artifact_ids or stored_result):
323	                raise ValueError("large_adapter_output_requires_durable_reference")
324	            duration_ms = int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)
325	            labels = execution_labels(name, result.data)
326	            status = "SUCCEEDED" if result.status == "ok" else "FAILED"
327	            if result.status == "error" and result.error_code in DETERMINISTIC_FAILURES:
328	                self._failed[repeat_key] = result.error_code
329	            self.calls.record_outcome(
330	                call_id=call_id, status=status,
331	                result_json={"status": result.status,
332	                             "data_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(result.data, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
333	                             "artifact_ids": list(result.artifact_ids), "attempt": attempt,
334	                             "arguments": arguments, "duration_ms": duration_ms,
335	                             # Exit code, timeout and qualification only (ints and bools), never output text.
336	                             **({"execution": labels} if labels else {})},
337	                error_code=result.error_code, evidence_ids=result.evidence_ids,
338	            )
339	            events.finish(outcome_from_row(status, result.error_code), evidence_ids=result.evidence_ids,
340	                          artifact_ids=result.artifact_ids, error_code=result.error_code,
341	                          duration_ms=duration_ms, labels=labels)
342	            return result
343	        except BaseException as exc:
344	            definite = isinstance(exc, ToolError)
345	            if authorized:
